hypotheses.claim: FRANK visual online learning needs two independently testable gates: an evidence/provenance gate for durable state promotion and a current-validity/coherence gate for familiarity fast-path recognition.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: One sufficiently calibrated classifier/confidence gate is enough for both safe learning and safe fast-path recognition.
hypotheses.falsifier: On real frozen Retina replay, a single gate matches or beats the dual-gate design on false familiarity, knowledge-growth benefit, compute, poisoning resistance and rollback cost.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Matched real-Retina replay: single confidence gate vs evidence-admission-only vs validity-only vs dual gate, with near-confusers, stale versions, distribution shift and trusted corrections.

hypotheses.claim: Memory update policy should distinguish smooth drift from abrupt conflict/shock: cheap incremental adaptation for coherent drift, challenged-candidate/reconsolidation logic only when evidence indicates a regime change or contradiction.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: One conservative reconsolidation policy is robust across both smooth drift and abrupt shocks.
hypotheses.falsifier: A universal policy dominates regime-conditioned control across matched drift/shock traces without excess latency, forgetting or error.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Harness paired smooth-drift and abrupt-shock twins with CAMRL lesion/rescue and budget matching.

hypotheses.claim: Directed-flow/TE-style readouts should be represented below intervention-supported causal status; stronger re-entry or emergence claims require common-driver controls plus matched lesion/rescue or equivalent discriminating interventions.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Robust directed prediction with shuffle/null controls is sufficient to identify functional causal re-entry in FRANK.
hypotheses.falsifier: Across confounded and true-coupling Harness twins, observational metrics alone achieve the same calibrated causal discrimination as matched interventions.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Golden confounded-vs-true-coupling twins with topology hash, conditioning identity, edge lesion, delay perturbation, shuffled re-entry and rescue.

hypotheses.claim: A derived state becomes CURRENT only after source/materialization admission identity, schema-safe named binding, projection completeness semantics and atomic publication/retraction closure are satisfied.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: External boot validation plus epoch numbers and current invalidation queues already provide equivalent safety without an explicit publication contract.
hypotheses.falsifier: H1/H2 crash/concurrency/schema-mutation tests show no mixed-current or stale-edge failures under the simpler existing boundary.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Schema reorder/default/required-field mutations plus PATCH/COMPLETE_SNAPSHOT retraction, crash-mid-publication and replay differential fixtures.

hypotheses.claim: As verified Unified Memory about an entity increases, FRANK should improve recognition quality and/or reduce Retina compute while not increasing false familiarity or conflict suppression.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Additional verified semantic memory does not materially improve visual recognition beyond a fixed visual matcher and may instead create confirmation bias.
hypotheses.falsifier: UMV-E5 shows no positive quality/cost curve or shows rising false familiarity after controlling for observation count and compute.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Longitudinal frozen-entity replay with controlled memory increments, lookalikes and misleading priors; measure recognition, abstention, compute and calibration jointly.

hypotheses.claim: Current ClayCode G9 typed records/enums/events plus existing effect boundaries are likely sufficient to represent the newly fused calibration, provenance, causal-receipt and adaptive-memory contracts; BASE should implement/compiler-test these before adding language primitives.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: At least one fused contract cannot be expressed/lowered deterministically without a new ClayCode primitive.
hypotheses.falsifier: A minimal FRANK component using all fused receipts fails type/effect/canonicalization/lowering or requires opaque host semantics despite complete existing G9 implementation.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Compile one executable Unified Memory<->Retina component exercising candidate promotion, calibration invalidation, conflict, causal receipt, rollback and replay using only frozen G9 constructs.

anti_echo_result: Mechanisms sharing FRANK/Retina/UnifiedDB ancestry are treated as convergent constraints, not independent replication. The invalidated familiarity duplicate contributes no independent count.
promotion_decision: NO_CANONICAL_SCIENTIFIC_PROMOTION; hypotheses are refined/open and routed to executable BASE/Harness discriminators.
